name: Contributions
title: Contributions: every pull request to rouh-core reviewed for the owner in plain words, with four answers

permissions: on the Creator Rouh only (the one that makes Rouh's releases): reads rouh-core's open pull requests, their files and their checks from GitHub's public API every half hour, unsigned
asks the Models setting Reviewing a pull request to describe each one, with the pull request's text read as data only
puts each reviewed pull request on Decisions, once a week together with one digest notice, a security fix at once
starts a run for each answer (merge, ask for changes, decline, rebuild our way), which reaches GitHub only as the owner through their grant
jobs: the look at rouh-core's pull requests, every half hour (runtime._contributions_loop), and the weekly digest on Mondays from 09:00 on the owner's clock
touches.remove: rouh/contributions.py, rouh/management/commands/contributions.py, ContributionSource in rouh/decision_sources.py, the loop and hooks in rouh/runtime.py, the use contribution_review in rouh/modeldefaults.py and rouh/model_standard.json, and this manifest. Answered decisions stay in History.
